This city is pure elegance, filled with stunning architecture and rich history everywhere you turn. You can feel the classical music vibes everywhere, and there are coffee houses showing up all over the place. 

I also love watching the Viennese people too; they seem to be having a blast with their families and friends, catching opera shows, dining out, and definitely rocking their personal style in a way that totally fits the city’s vibe.

I’ve come across some ladies in their 80s who totally know how to own their style, almost like they’ve stepped out of a different era. They even put on bright red lipstick just to hit the grocery store, and honestly, that’s pretty inspiring.

Gerstner K. u. K. Hofzuckerbäcker is a famous Viennese imperial patisserie and confectioner’s, founded in 1847 by Anton and Barbara Gerstner.

The establishment, which was awarded the title of purveyor to the Imperial and Royal Court (K.u.K. Hofzuckerbäcker) in 1873, is situated in the Todesco Palace (Kärntner Straße 51), a stone’s throw from the Vienna State Opera. It offers a gastronomic experience spread over three floors:

Ground floor: A shop selling artisanal pastries, chocolates and confectionery.
First floor: A café-bar with a spectacular view of the Opera House.
Second floor: A café-restaurant set in sumptuous historic rooms (the grand ballroom and private lounges).
Gerstner is renowned for its traditional Viennese specialities such as Sachertorte, Apfelstrudel and the house-made cakes. The company also offers pastry-making demonstrations (the ‘Gerstner Show’) and has another branch at Schönbrunn Palace.

Vienna has a stunning new restaurant – hidden inside a former imperial post office! 👀✨

Meet RASCAL, a stylish new brasserie in Vienna’s city center, where historic grandeur meets contemporary design, creative cuisine and a cheeky attitude.

And the name says it all! 😈

“Rascal” means a mischievous troublemaker – and this restaurant embraces that playful, rebellious spirit. Expect unexpected twists, a little culinary theatre and a dining experience that doesn’t take itself too seriously.

🍽️ Here’s what makes RASCAL special:

🏛️ The location – a former imperial post office transformed into a spectacular restaurant with soaring ceilings and striking interiors.

😈 The concept – cheeky, playful and unconventional. Classic brasserie dining with a rebellious twist.

🍴 The food – Austrian and European classics reimagined with creative touches and surprising presentations.

🎭 Tableside theatre – selected dishes are finished right at your table for an extra dose of entertainment.

📍 RASCAL – Dominikanerbastei 15, 1010 Vienna, Austria

Vienna’s seafood scene has been such a pleasant surprise 🦑

Who would have thought that a landlocked city could serve seafood this exquisite?

I stumbled upon this Italian restaurant before my VIVALDI: Vier Jahreszeiten performance at Karlskirche. Torn between the monkfish and grilled squid, I went with the waiter’s recommendation - and couldn’t have been happier.

The grilled squid was succulent, incredibly fresh, and beautifully balanced. Hearty yet delicate, with the quality of the seafood speaking for itself. Honestly, I was blown away. ✨

Vienna’s location at the crossroads of Central Europe has historically made it an important trading hub, connecting different culinary traditions. And this little Italian restaurant was the perfect reminder that great seafood isn’t just found in coastal cities.

I came here solo, otherwise I’d have loved to try more dishes. With its exquisite food and cozy, intimate atmosphere, this place is definitely worth a visit!

🎬 **SPECIAL FILM SCREENING | 31 OCTOBER, 2 PM**

Join us for a very special screening of *artist*, a film by Lydia Nsiah, exploring the world of barbershops through the themes of self-care, masculinity and artistic expression.

Set in Vienna’s Mr. Artist Barbershop, this intimate 16mm film celebrates togetherness, care and sensitivity. Filmed by hand, the camera moves closely with the protagonists, capturing the skilled gestures of the barbers in a sensual dialogue with the filmmaker’s own movements. Warm analogue images, experimental montage and immersive sound composed by musician Rojin Sharafi create a distinctive cinematic experience.

The screening will introduce our themed discussion: Are barbershops for everyone? Who feels welcome in these spaces, and how do they shape our ideas of masculinity, identity and belonging?

✨ Come and be entertained, discover Lydia Nsiah’s artistic vision, and join us for an open and engaging discussion afterwards.

🔥 Warm, knusprig, süß – der Crumble‑Hype aus London und New York hat die österreichische Dessertszene im Sturm erobert!

„Krumble by Eis‑Greissler“ wird ab Samstag, 24. Oktober, frisch in Bechern serviert: zarte Vanillesoße, saftige Fruchtsoße, knusprige Streusel und ein Hauch von Kaffee- oder Schokoladengeschmack, den du selbst aussuchst. Bei der feierlichen Eröffnung in der Rotenturmstraße haben wir die Top‑Influencer der Region eingeladen, die begeistert bestätigten: „Das schmeckt richtig geil.“ In jedem Becher schmilzt die warme Schale von Vanille, während die Streusel im Mund knistern und die Fruchtsoße einen erfrischenden Kontrast bildet. Unsere Gäste konnten bereits die perfekte Kombination aus süß und leicht herben Aromen erleben – ein wahres Fest für die Sinne. Wir haben nicht nur das Dessert, sondern auch die Atmosphäre auf ein neues Level gehoben: die fröhliche Musik, die warmen Lichter und die Lächeln der Besucher machten den Abend unvergesslich. Und das Beste: Du kannst diesen Traum in Wien, Graz, Linz, Salzburg und Klagenfurt genießen – bis Ende Februar 2027.

Vienna’s seafood scene has been such a pleasant surprise 🦑

Who would have thought that a landlocked city could serve seafood this exquisite?

I stumbled upon this Italian restaurant before my VIVALDI: Vier Jahreszeiten performance at Karlskirche. Torn between the monkfish and grilled squid, I went with the waiter’s recommendation - and couldn’t have been happier.

The grilled squid was succulent, incredibly fresh, and beautifully balanced. Hearty yet delicate, with the quality of the seafood speaking for itself. Honestly, I was blown away. ✨

Vienna’s location at the crossroads of Central Europe has historically made it an important trading hub, connecting different culinary traditions. And this little Italian restaurant was the perfect reminder that great seafood isn’t just found in coastal cities.

I came here solo, otherwise I’d have loved to try more dishes. With its exquisite food and cozy, intimate atmosphere, this place is definitely worth a visit!

🎡 Wiener Prater – inklusive legendärer Runde im Riesenrad
⛪ Stephansdom – DAS Wahrzeichen mitten im Herzen Wiens
🎨 MuseumsQuartier – Kunst, Kultur und ziemlich viel zu entdecken
🏛️ Historische Innenstadt – perfekt, um Wien gemeinsam zu erkunden
🌳 Donauinsel – raus aus dem Großstadttrubel und eine kleine Pause einlegen
